summary: Corrected the replay-completion account's schedule-variation limitation after checking the retained receipts: the availability pair is not single-run but has three executions with the same split. The later two are receipts produced by the configuration-recovery investigation's multi-node harness, which contains the availability case among its four cases, and they reproduce it identically (fe822d82c6264158826e0303b4ce59b1 and 67fc59b525e54d01b709a19592689357, events 9-14 each: staged commit index 3001 with the replay enabled and 3000 with it disabled, the replay-enabled restart not returning, the group committing with two members live and losing the ability after the second stop, and the control returning in 0ms and committing). Both are now cited in executions with a joint_history note explaining that they are shared across the two investigations and re-observe this case under the same fixed inputs. The limitation now reads that the bound pair remains single-run while the availability pair has three executions; the rest of the account - sources, the other six receipts, knowledge uses, conclusion and counterevidence - is unchanged.
